## Two Methodological Decisions
1. **Which nodes to include?** All entities or only **agency** nodes?
2. **What to do with isolates?** Keep or **drop**?
Sample size: 559--560 (with isolates) $\rightarrow$ **406** (all nodes, no isolates) $\rightarrow$ **332** (agency, no isolates)
## Agency Node Types {.scrollable}
```{r agency_types, echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tibble)
types <- tibble::tribble(
  ~"Kept (Agency)", ~"Removed (Non-Agency)",
  "Local_GSA",      "Basin",
  "Other_GSA",      "Natural_Feature",
  "District",       "Infrastructure",
  "Local_Gov",      "Technical",
  "State_Gov",      "Water_Project",
  "Federal_Gov",    "Reference",
  "City",           "Geographic_Unit",
  "County",         "Legal",
  "Group",          "Data_System",
  "NGO",            "Nonsense",
  "Company",        "",
  "Person",         ""
)
kable(types, align = "c", format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

## Unfiltered vs Agency-Filtered: Full Comparison {.scrollable}
```{r mode_comparison, echo=FALSE}
results <- tibble::tribble(
  ~"Hypothesis",     ~"Original (N≈559)",  ~"Tagged (N=406)",   ~"Agency (N=332)",
  "In-degree",       "-0.170***",          "-0.121**",          "0.019 (NS)",
  "Out-degree",      "-0.312***",          "-0.269***",         "-0.281***",
  "Total degree",    "---",                "-0.180***",         "-0.109**",
  "Leader distance", "0.081**",            "0.008 (NS)",        "-0.117**"
)
kable(results, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c"), format = "html",
      caption = "DAC coefficients across network modes (Poisson GLM)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
  column_spec(4, bold = TRUE)
```
::: {.fragment}
Note: Original mode still includes isolates; Tagged and Agency modes drop isolates.
:::

## Leader Distance Reversal
The most striking change is in leader distance:

| | Original | Tagged (no isolates) | Agency (no isolates) |
|---|---|---|---|
| DAC | **+0.081\*\*** (farther) | **0.008** (NS) | **-0.117\*\*** (closer) |

- In the original network (with isolates), DAC places appeared farther from GSA leadership
- Removing isolates alone eliminates the effect --- the signal was driven by isolated places assigned to the network diameter
- In the agency-only network, DAC places are actually **closer** to GSA nodes
